title: Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) — Telugu + English Learning
subtitle: Original English diagrams, tile headings, formulas, code unchanged · Natural Telugu + English learning.
hero:
LONG SHORT-TERM MEMORY · VISUAL OVERVIEW

Remember useful clues while a sequence keeps moving.

LSTMs use gates to decide what to keep, what new information to add, and what to reveal at each step.

questions.stem: Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) అంటే ఏమిటి? RNNలో Special Gates Important Sequence Informationని Longer Time పాటు ఎలా Carry చేస్తాయి?
questions.figure:
VISUAL EXPLANATION

An LSTM carries memory forward one step at a time

The LSTM reads events in order and carries useful information forward using a gated memory state.
options: LSTM Every Tokenని Fixed Lookup Valueగా Store చేసి Stateని Never Update చేస్తుంది.
LSTM Previous Observations Remove చేసి Time Steps Completely Independently Read చేస్తుంది.
LSTM Gated Cell Memory, Recurrenceతో Important Information Across Steps Carry చేస్తుంది.
LSTM Self-Attentionతో All Tokens Parallel Read చేసి Any Hidden State Maintain చేయదు.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: LSTM ఒక RNN, కానీ Memoryకి Gates ఉంటాయి. Useful Cluesని Keep చేసి Irrelevant Informationని Forget చేయగలదు.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: C. LSTM Current Input x_t, Prior Hidden h_(t−1), Cell c_(t−1)తో Forget/Input/Output Gates Compute చేస్తుంది. New Cell c_t, Hidden h_t Create అవుతాయి. Gates Learned, Not Handwritten Memory Rules.

questions.stem: Traditional RNNలో Vanishing Gradient Problemకి LSTM Additive Cell Memory, Gates ఎలా Help చేస్తాయి? ఇది Guaranteed Fix ఎందుకు కాదు?
questions.figure:
VISUAL EXPLANATION

Why gates can make long-term learning easier

A basic RNN can lose learning signals over many steps. LSTM memory helps signals survive longer.
options: LSTM Gates, Additive Cell-State Pathway Long-Term Gradient Flowకి Help చేయవచ్చు.
Ordinary RNN Every Distant Detail Perfectly Remember చేస్తుంది; Gradient Problems Never Occur.
LSTM Backpropagation Entirely Remove చేసి Training Gradientsని Compute చేయదు.
LSTM Vanishing, Exploding Gradients Any Sequenceలో Completely Eliminate చేస్తుంది.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: Simple RNNలో Old Learning Signal Weak అవొచ్చు. LSTM Cell Path, Gates Long-Distance Learningకి Help చేస్తాయి.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: A. Traditional RNN Long Jacobian Products వల్ల Vanishing/Exploding Gradients. LSTM c_t=f_t⊙c_(t−1)+i_t⊙g_t Additive Path ద్వారా Some Gradients Preserve చేయగలదు; Forget Gate Values, Long Sequenceపై Still Depend.

questions.stem: “I grew up in France ... now I speak fluent French” Sentenceలో LSTM France Clueని Later Wordsవరకు ఎలా Retain చేయగలదు?
questions.figure:
VISUAL EXPLANATION

The France clue can stay in memory until it becomes useful

The model can keep the France clue while other words arrive, then use it when interpreting French.
options: “France” Wordని Every Later Tokenలో Repeat చేస్తేనే LSTM Meaning Store చేయగలదు.
LSTM Each Word తర్వాత All Memory Reset చేస్తుంది; Earlier Clues Cannot Survive.
Output Gate Wordsని Alphabetically Sort చేసి France Clueని Later Use చేస్తుంది.
France Clue Cell Stateలో Stays; Gates Updates, Outputని Control చేస్తాయి.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: “France” అనే Earlier Clueని LSTM Cell Stateలో Retain చేసి Later “French”తో Connect చేయవచ్చు.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: D. France Reference Cell Stateలో Learned Representationగా Persist కావచ్చు. Gates Later Inputs Process చేస్తూ Relevant Component Keep చేసి “French” Token దగ్గర Predictionకి Support చేయవచ్చు. Exact Token Copy కాదు.

questions.stem: LSTM Forget Gate, Input Gate, Output Gate, Cell State, Hidden State Together Informationని ఎలా Keep, Update, Reveal చేస్తాయి?
questions.figure:
VISUAL EXPLANATION

Forget, input, and output gates play different roles

Forget controls old memory, input adds new content, and output controls what the cell reveals.
options: Input Gate All Memory Delete; Forget Gate Next Predicted Wordని Direct Choose చేస్తుంది.
Forget/Input Gates Cell Update; Output Gate Visible Hidden Stateని Control చేస్తుంది.
Only Hidden State Change; Cell State Whole Sequenceలో Fixedగా Remains.
Output Gate Training Next Epochలో Weights Update Allow చేయాలా Decide చేస్తుంది.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: Forget Gate Old Memory ఎంత Keep చేయాలో, Input Gate ఏమి Add చేయాలో, Output Gate ఏమి Show చేయాలో Decide చేస్తాయి.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: B. f_t=σ(W_f[x_t;h_(t−1)]+b_f), i_t Similar, o_t Similar; g_t=tanh(W_g[..]+b_g). c_t=f_t⊙c_(t−1)+i_t⊙g_t; h_t=o_t⊙tanh(c_t). ఇక్కడ Forget Gate Old Cell Memoryని Scale చేస్తుంది; Input Gate New Candidate Add చేస్తుంది; Output Gate Hidden Stateని Control చేస్తుంది.

questions.stem: Sigmoid, tanh, Elementwise Multiplicationతో LSTM Equations cₜ=fₜ⊙cₜ₋₁+iₜ⊙gₜ, hₜ=oₜ⊙tanh(cₜ) ఎలా Compute అవుతాయి?
questions.figure:
VISUAL EXPLANATION

Calculate memory 0.62 and hidden output about 0.386

The forget gate keeps part of old memory. Input adds a candidate. Output reveals part of the result.
options: Cell State All Previous Inputs Add మాత్రమే చేస్తుంది; Gates, Nonlinearity అవసరం లేదు.
Gates Whole Sequenceపై Softmax Use చేసి Sum Exactly One Guarantee చేస్తాయి.
Forget Old Memory; Input Adds Candidate; Output Gate Reveals Hidden State చేస్తుంది.
Sigmoid Outputs Negative; Tanh Values Always One కంటే Greaterగా వస్తాయి.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: Old Memoryలో ఒక Part Keep చేసి New Candidateని Add చేస్తాం. Output Gate Updated Memory నుంచి Hidden State Create చేస్తుంది.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: C. Sigmoid Gate Outputs 0..1, tanh Candidate −1..1. Example c_old=0.8, f=0.9, i=0.2, g=0.5 అయితే c_new=0.9×0.8+0.2×0.5=0.82. Output Gate h_new=o×tanh(0.82).

questions.stem: Backpropagation Through Time (BPTT) LSTMకి Gradients ఎలా పంపుతుంది? Gated Memoryతో Stability Improve అయినా Exploding Gradients ఎందుకు Remaining Problem?
questions.figure:
VISUAL EXPLANATION

Training sends error signals backward through earlier time steps

BPTT learns from earlier time steps. Gates help gradients travel, but exploding gradients can still happen.
options: BPTT Backward Through Steps; Gated Additive Memory Gradient Flowకి Help చేస్తుంది.
BPTT Final Time Step Only Update చేస్తుంది; Earlier Inputs, Parameters Ignore చేస్తుంది.
Forget Gate Exploding Gradients Impossible చేస్తుంది; Clipping Never Needed.
LSTM Unlimited Detailed Memory Keep చేస్తుంది; Capacity, Parameters No Limit.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: BPTT All Stepsకి Learning Signals Send చేస్తుంది. LSTM Gates Long Gradients Help చేసినా Clipping, Stability Checks Still Need.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: A. BPTT Recurrent Gates Unroll చేసి Shared Weightsకి Derivatives Compute చేస్తుంది. Cell Path Gradient Signalని Preserve చేయొచ్చు; Forget Gates Long Products, Other Pathsకి Vanishing/Exploding Risk Still ఉంటుంది. Gradient Clipping Useful.

questions.stem: Bidirectional LSTM, Stacked LSTM, Attention LSTM vs GRU, Transformer Architectures Long Context, Parallel Training, Speech, Time-Series Tasksలో ఎలా Compare అవుతాయి?
questions.figure:
VISUAL EXPLANATION

Five ways to extend or replace a basic LSTM

Bidirectional models read both directions; stacking and attention add capabilities. GRUs are simpler, while Transformers train more in parallel.
options: Bidirectional LSTM Future Tokens Before Arriving Live Causal Predictionలో Use చేస్తుంది.
Stacked LSTM Recurrence Remove చేసి All Sequence Steps Fully Parallel Compute చేస్తుంది.
GRU Every Speech Taskలో LSTM, Transformer రెండింటినీ Always Outperforms చేస్తుంది.
Bidirectional Ways; Stacked Depth; Attention Context; Transformer Parallel చేస్తుంది.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: Bidirectional Both-Side Context Use చేస్తుంది; Stacked LSTM More Layers Add చేస్తుంది. Attention Earlier States Focus చేస్తుంది; Transformers More Parallel Train అవుతాయి.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: D. Bidirectional LSTM Future Observed Context Use, Strict Streamingలో Unseen Future Read చేయలేదు. Stacked Layers Depth; Attention History Focus. GRU Single Hidden State Gates Simpler; Transformers Positionwise Parallel Training, Different Memory/Compute Trade-offs.
